title: Civic Center Future and Spending Rules
summary:
*   Held a work session discussing the city's financial guidelines for social functions and events.
*   Received a report outlining the potential costs associated with the future Civic Center project.
*   Explored various strategic options and possibilities for the development of the Civic Center.
